name: Bob, Reluctant HYDRA Agent
oracle_text: Whenever Bob attacks alone, return him to his owner's hand. If you do, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
flavor_text: "I mainly joined up for the benefits . . ."

name: Boom Box
oracle_text: {6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, and up to one target land.
flavor_text: The cruel irony of explosives is they're most interesting exactly when you should be running away as fast as you can.

name: Braids, Cabal Minion
oracle_text: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices an artifact, creature, or land of their choice.
flavor_text: "Home is where you can find a decent graveyard and strangers can disappear without awkward questions."

name: Bushy Bodyguard
oracle_text:
Offspring {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.)
When this creature enters, you may forage. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on it. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.)

name: Circuits Act
oracle_text: Roll three six-sided dice. For each different result, create a 1/1 white Clown Robot artifact creature token.
flavor_text: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

name: Corpseberry Cultivator
oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may forage. (Exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.)
Whenever you forage, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
flavor_text: A rare fruit grows from the corpses of Calamity Beasts, with nectar the flavor of strength and skin as fragile as life.

name: Corrosive Ooze
oracle_text: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by an equipped creature, destroy all Equipment attached to that creature at end of combat.
flavor_text: Nothing tastes finer to an ooze than a priceless family heirloom.

name: Crimson Hellkite
oracle_text:
Flying
{X}, {T}: This creature deals X damage to target creature. Spend only red mana on X.
flavor_text: The hellkites are artists with flames, painting the world with fire.

name: Curious Forager
oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may forage. When you do, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.)
flavor_text: The bones of Calamity Beasts are sometimes buried in caches where their power can grow quietly.

name: Dina's Guidance
oracle_text: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand or graveyard, then shuffle.
flavor_text: "This last step is very important. You'll need to know if the friend you're searching for is alive or dead."

name: Fendeep Summoner
oracle_text: {T}: Up to two target Swamps each become 3/5 Treefolk Warrior creatures in addition to their other types until end of turn.
flavor_text: "What is drowned is not forgotten. I will fulfill my oath. Come back to me, my brethren, as I have come back for you."

name: Goatnapper
oracle_text: When this creature enters, untap target Goat and gain control of it until end of turn. It gains haste until end of turn.
flavor_text: Kith goats are just for practice. The real prize, of course, is a giant's cloudgoat.

name: Groffskithur
oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, you may return target card named Groffskithur from your graveyard to your hand.
flavor_text: It growls not to threaten, but to summon.

name: Gruul Ragebeast
oracle_text: Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, that creature fights target creature an opponent controls.
flavor_text:
"If the other guilds want a war, they should know we've been ready the whole time."
—Ruric Thar, Ghor-Clan chieftain

name: Guiding Spirit
oracle_text:
Flying
{T}: If the top card of target player's graveyard is a creature card, put that card on top of that player's library.
flavor_text:
"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Hatchet Bully
oracle_text: {2}{R}, {T}, Put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control: This creature deals 2 damage to any target.
flavor_text: "It's not much for eating, but I think we can find somethin' to do with it."

name: Heightened Awareness
oracle_text:
As this enchantment enters, discard your hand.
At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card.
flavor_text:
"It startles me how alive one feels on the edge of death."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Hellrider
oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever a creature you control attacks, this creature deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
flavor_text:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Irreverent Gremlin
oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. Do this only once each turn.

name: Longhorn Firebeast
oracle_text: When this creature enters, any opponent may have it deal 5 damage to them. If a player does, sacrifice this creature.
flavor_text: Its blast can fuse armor to bone, leaving skeletons that glint brightly in the sun.

name: Mageta the Lion
oracle_text: {2}{W}{W}, {T}, Discard two cards: Destroy all creatures except for Mageta. Those creatures can't be regenerated.
flavor_text: In the jungle of war there is always a Lion.

name: Mine Worker
oracle_text: {T}: You gain 1 life. If you control creatures named Power Plant Worker and Tower Worker, you gain 3 life instead.
flavor_text: Following his hunger for knowledge and power from the past, Urza starved Dominaria's future.

name: Non-Human Cannonball
oracle_text: When this creature dies, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 4 or less, this creature deals that much damage to you.
flavor_text: Designed for maximum impact, comedic and otherwise.

name: Overlaid Terrain
oracle_text:
As this enchantment enters, sacrifice all lands you control.
Lands you control have "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."
flavor_text: One must reap before one can sow.

name: Reverse Polarity
oracle_text: You gain X life, where X is twice the damage dealt to you so far this turn by artifacts.

name: Ride Down
oracle_text: Destroy target blocking creature. Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn.
flavor_text: The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads of cultists and horrors, opening the way for the villagers to flee Thraben.

name: Sawtooth Ogre
oracle_text: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, this creature deals 1 damage to that creature at end of combat.
flavor_text: "You will sharpen your teeth on my enemies' bones," Maraxus promised them, and his ogres cheered.

name: Scourglass
oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy all permanents except for artifacts and lands. Activate only during your upkeep.
flavor_text:
"Soon I will sleep, eyes closing to a world tarnished with flesh, and then wake to a polished vision."
—Sharuum

name: Slavering Nulls
oracle_text: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, if you control a Swamp, you may have that player discard a card.
set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
flavor_text: Having lost their minds, they now want yours.

name: Soul Charmer
oracle_text: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, you gain 2 life unless that creature's controller pays {2}.
flavor_text: She seeks the warmth of the living.

name: Spreading Plague
oracle_text: Whenever a creature enters, destroy all other creatures that share a color with it. They can't be regenerated.
flavor_text: The cruelest strain of plague keeps its hosts alive long enough to return home and infect their families.

name: Steadfast Armasaur
oracle_text:
Vigilance
{1}{W}, {T}: This creature deals damage equal to its toughness to target creature blocking or blocked by it.
flavor_text:
"Like the mighty armasaur, we will defend against all who invade our shores."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Treetop Sentries
oracle_text:
Reach
When this creature enters, you may forage. If you do, draw a card. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.)
flavor_text: They don't waste arrows on warning shots.

name: Venom
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature blocks or becomes blocked by a non-Wall creature, destroy the other creature at end of combat.
flavor_text:
"I told him it was just a flesh wound, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone."
—Maeveen O'Donagh,
*Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Vexing Devil
oracle_text: When this creature enters, any opponent may have it deal 4 damage to them. If a player does, sacrifice this creature.
flavor_text: It's not any fun until someone loses an eye.

name: Wall of Dust
oracle_text:
Defender (This creature can't attack.)
Whenever this creature blocks a creature, that creature can't attack during its controller's next turn.
flavor_text: An ever-moving swarm of dust engulfs and disorients anything that comes near.

name: Warchanter Skald
oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, if it's enchanted or equipped, create a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token.
flavor_text: "Who will be the hero of my tale?"
